verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a datacenter GPU accelerator. A story about bulk operations across many items (batch-editing records or objects in an application) is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows fleet tooling such as AMD SMI, the GPU Operator and the Cluster Validation Suite, but none of it documents user-facing bulk operations across items, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
